description: D2: the warning post where the way up from the Mere reaches the Stormstair's pools - shown once as the giant passes it, never after the Stormcaller has fallen.
text: The Stormstair: flooded pools stepping up under the Stonehold's wall, and standing in the storm over them a giant with a rod as tall as he is - the Stormcaller. His bolts come down where red circles show. On the water a bolt's shock runs through it: the deeper you stand in it, the harder it takes you. He stands in it too.
